claims.formula: (()=>{const erf=x=>{const t=Math.abs(x);let r;if(t<3){let s=t,term=t;for(let n=1;n<200;n++){term*=-t*t/n;s+=term/(2*n+1);}r=2/Math.sqrt(Math.PI)*s;}else{let f=0;for(let q=60;q>=1;q--)f=q/2/(t+f);r=1-Math.exp(-t*t)/Math.sqrt(Math.PI)/(t+f);}return x<0?-r:r;};const Phi=x=>0.5*(1+erf(x/Math.SQRT2));const invPhi=u=>{let lo=-10,hi=10;for(let i=0;i<200;i++){const m=(lo+hi)/2;if(Phi(m)<u)lo=m;else hi=m;}return (lo+hi)/2;};const mb=a=>()=>{a|=0;a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296;};const sim=(seed,years,rho)=>{const r=mb(seed),c=invPhi(p),nrm=()=>{const u1=1-r(),u2=r();return Math.sqrt(-2*Math.log(u1))*Math.cos(2*Math.PI*u2);};const out=[];for(let y=0;y<years;y++){const Z=nrm();let f=0;for(let j=0;j<n;j++){const e=nrm();if(Math.sqrt(rho)*Z+Math.sqrt(1-rho)*e<c)f++;}out.push(f);}return out;};const o=sim(seed,years,rho);return o.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);})()

claims.text: chance at least 5 of 10 fail, independent
claims.formula: (()=>{const erf=x=>{const t=Math.abs(x);let r;if(t<3){let s=t,term=t;for(let n=1;n<200;n++){term*=-t*t/n;s+=term/(2*n+1);}r=2/Math.sqrt(Math.PI)*s;}else{let f=0;for(let q=60;q>=1;q--)f=q/2/(t+f);r=1-Math.exp(-t*t)/Math.sqrt(Math.PI)/(t+f);}return x<0?-r:r;};const Phi=x=>0.5*(1+erf(x/Math.SQRT2));const invPhi=u=>{let lo=-10,hi=10;for(let i=0;i<200;i++){const m=(lo+hi)/2;if(Phi(m)<u)lo=m;else hi=m;}return (lo+hi)/2;};const C=(a,b)=>{let r=1;for(let i=0;i<b;i++)r=r*(a-i)/(i+1);return r;};const tail=(q,kk)=>{let s=0;for(let j=kk;j<=n;j++)s+=C(n,j)*q**j*(1-q)**(n-j);return s;};const P=(r,kk)=>{if(r===0)return 100*tail(p,kk);const c=invPhi(p),h=0.001;let s=0;for(let z=-8+h/2;z<8;z+=h){s+=tail(Phi((c-Math.sqrt(r)*z)/Math.sqrt(1-r)),kk)*Math.exp(-z*z/2)/Math.sqrt(2*Math.PI)*h;}return 100*s;};return P(rho,k);})()

claims.formula: (()=>{const erf=x=>{const t=Math.abs(x);let r;if(t<3){let s=t,term=t;for(let n=1;n<200;n++){term*=-t*t/n;s+=term/(2*n+1);}r=2/Math.sqrt(Math.PI)*s;}else{let f=0;for(let q=60;q>=1;q--)f=q/2/(t+f);r=1-Math.exp(-t*t)/Math.sqrt(Math.PI)/(t+f);}return x<0?-r:r;};const Phi=x=>0.5*(1+erf(x/Math.SQRT2));const invPhi=u=>{let lo=-10,hi=10;for(let i=0;i<200;i++){const m=(lo+hi)/2;if(Phi(m)<u)lo=m;else hi=m;}return (lo+hi)/2;};const mb=a=>()=>{a|=0;a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296;};const sim=(seed,years,rho)=>{const r=mb(seed),c=invPhi(p),nrm=()=>{const u1=1-r(),u2=r();return Math.sqrt(-2*Math.log(u1))*Math.cos(2*Math.PI*u2);};const out=[];for(let y=0;y<years;y++){const Z=nrm();let f=0;for(let j=0;j<n;j++){const e=nrm();if(Math.sqrt(rho)*Z+Math.sqrt(1-rho)*e<c)f++;}out.push(f);}return out;};const o=sim(mcSeed,mcDraws,rho);return 100*o.filter(x=>x>=k).length/mcDraws;})()
